column1: # The single global floor lets a well-covered package hide a poor one:
# pkg/query at 63.0% sits under the same 74.0% gate as pkg/parallel at 93.4%,
# and the total stays above it either way.
# EVERY NUMBER HERE CAME FROM CI, NOT FROM A DEVELOPER MACHINE.
# Source: run 33159364069 on main, job "Code Coverage", 2026-08-28.
# This repository has a four-point gap between the two environments, and a
# floor set from the wrong one failed every pull request until #469 re-measured
# it. Regenerate with `make coverage-floors-update` against a CI profile, never
# The floor is the measured value less two points. That absorbs the ordinary
# run-to-run variation without absorbing a real slide: a package that drops
